newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open bit weaker on caution over rally.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open bit weaker on caution over rally.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened a touch weaker on Tuesday after five consecutive days of gains in the key market index.
Brokers said participants had become slightly cautious about the rally after the 225-share Nikkei average climbed above 18,500 points for the first time in about a month on Monday.

As of 0011 GMT, the Nikkei was down 51.91 points, or 0.28 percent, at 18,499.75. June Nikkei futures had lost 80 points to 18,500. But brokers said the key Nikkei index was likely to regain ground soon, helped by continuing demand for shares with solid earnings forecasts.
"After the market absorbs profit taking, the Nikkei 225 should head upwards again," said a broker at a second-tier Japanese securities house.
